summary: Customer interested in expansion but pricing concerns remain.
Customer requested ROI justification and implementation timeline.

Discussed Construction Cloud fit for design-to-build handoff. Seller committed to send proposal, ROI model, and onboarding timeline by Friday. Security review flagged. Forma deferred to separate conversation.
Outreach sent to David Nguyen re: Civil 3D renewal approaching in September.
Initial call with BrightPath. David confirmed renewal intent but wants to explore InfraWorks for upcoming highway project. Pain point: disconnected data between design and field teams.
Priya Sharma expressed interest in Forma for concept-phase generative design. Budget conversations deferred to Tom Barnes.
Sent Forma overview deck. Tom Barnes asked for pricing comparison vs. current Revit-only setup.
Technical demo of Construction Cloud completed. Mike Torres satisfied with BIM Collaborate Pro features. Lisa Chen flagged security review requirement.
Security review documentation sent to IT team. Awaiting sign-off.
Anna Brooks confirmed VRED is top priority for the team. Proposal submitted for 5 seats.
Follow-up sent. James Wu said decision expected by end of April.
Contract redline received from Rachel Kim. Two open items: payment terms and data residency clause.
Legal team reviewing data residency clause. Paul Adeyemi expects resolution by end of week.

The call was a follow-up to discuss the detailed proposal, ROI model, and onboarding plan for the Construction Cloud expansion. Mark Lee raised concerns about data residency, third-party access, and security documentation, requesting a security whitepaper and compliance details, and potentially a call with a security architect. Jane Smith emphasized the importance of smooth collaboration for external partners and ease of adoption, especially for design review and clash detection. Seller A addressed these points by confirming the provision of comprehensive security documentation and detailing Construction Cloud's multi-disciplinary collaboration features, integration with Revit, and phased 6-8 week onboarding plan with tailored training and support for both internal and external teams. Both stakeholders agreed to review the forthcoming documents and scheduled a follow-up call for the following Tuesday.
